llmo_llmo_stand.question: What does LLMO stand for?
llmo_llmo_stand.answer: LLMO stands for Large Language Model Optimization — structuring and publishing content so language models can retrieve and reuse it accurately.

llmo_llmo_different_from.question: How is LLMO different from LLM SEO?
llmo_llmo_different_from.answer: LLM SEO is the strategic goal of being known and recommended by models. LLMO is the technical execution layer that makes your content machine-retrievable in the first place.

llmo_content_chunking.question: What is content chunking?
llmo_content_chunking.answer: Retrieval systems split pages into passages, embed them and match them to queries. Chunking-friendly content uses clear headings and self-contained sections so each passage remains meaningful on its own.

llmo_i_need_llmstxt.question: Do I need llms.txt?
llmo_i_need_llmstxt.answer: It is optional and still an emerging convention, but it is cheap to add and gives LLM consumers a clean summary of your site and its key URLs. We include it in every LLMO engagement.

llmo_javascript_hurt_llm.question: Does JavaScript hurt LLM retrieval?
llmo_javascript_hurt_llm.answer: It can. Several AI crawlers do not execute JavaScript, so content that only appears after hydration is invisible to them. Server-side rendering solves this.

llmo_which_schema_types.question: Which schema types matter most for LLMO?
llmo_which_schema_types.answer: Organization and WebSite for identity, Service for offerings, Article for editorial content, FAQPage for question-answer pairs, LocalBusiness for physical presence and BreadcrumbList for context.

llmo_should_pdfs_be.question: Should PDFs be converted to HTML?
llmo_should_pdfs_be.answer: Usually yes. Key facts locked inside PDFs, images or embedded tools are far less reliably retrieved than the same information in HTML.

llmo_llmo_be_done.question: Can LLMO be done without changing site design?
llmo_llmo_be_done.answer: In most cases yes. The work is largely in markup, rendering and content structure rather than visual design.

llmo_i_know_llmo.question: How do I know LLMO is working?
llmo_i_know_llmo.answer: Retrieval tests improve first — assistants summarise your pages correctly when asked directly. Citation share in unprompted answers follows as content and authority work compounds.

llmo_llmo_oneoff_project.question: Is LLMO a one-off project?
llmo_llmo_oneoff_project.answer: The foundation is a project; keeping it true is ongoing. Every new template, redesign or CMS change can break rendering or schema, so we re-verify each quarter.
